request: Find all completed orders along with customer names and order dates.

reasoning.dependency_order: Join orders and customers on customer_id

response.sql: SELECT o.id, c.name AS customer_name, o.order_date, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'completed';
response.explanation: Joins orders and customers on customer_id to return completed orders.

request: Find the total amount spent by each customer and rank them by total spending.

reasoning.dependency_order: Join customers and orders, aggregate sum, compute DENSE_RANK window function

response.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC) AS spending_rank FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name;
response.explanation: Computes customer spending totals and uses PostgreSQL DENSE_RANK() to rank customers.
